book.title: Evangelio según Mateo Jesucristo roy pjl̈ú ëre, e jyã tara Mateorë

content: Juan No Waga zrörabae
Dbar eshkoshko ga Pjl̈u Herodes
parkë sök Galilea so ichaga. Jesús roy kuya ga
tjl̈ẽ ba parkagaga kong ga «E Juan No Waga l̈i woshrokdo. L̇l̇ëbo ĩydëba l̇l̇ëm wl̈eniyo shärye ga pjl̈ú e kjĩshko» l̈e.
Kjupäbäshko ga Juan tjl̈ẽ Herodes kong ga «Herodías kjwe kjrëp ber bop boy wl̈o ga ä, e bop shjiy Felipe boy kjĩshko» l̈e. E kjĩshko ga Juan shara, bängzara Herodesdë, shdũya wl̈o.
Zröya woydë, gueniyo «Juan, e Sbö tjl̈õkwo l̈aga» l̈ëba, ga oba bangkjre ara. E kjĩshko ga zröra l̇l̇ëme.
Öötong Herodes shrëzl̈ong dbaryoshko ga Herodías wa wal̈ë l̈i bërkono oba l̈öng kjl̈obi l̈i bokshto, ga Herodes beno sök wopjl̈ú e kjĩshko.
E kjĩshko ga tjl̈ẽno ba kong jl̈õkoyo ga l̇l̇ëye roke l̈i twe ba kong.
Poshduna ba mekërë kjĩshko ga tjl̈ẽ Herodes kong ga «Woydër ga no ichëp Juan No Waga kägä zë, ga tek söp bor kong kjwl̈ë roshko» l̈e.
Kuya ga woydë jonge. Gueniyo tjl̈ẽno jl̈õkoyo nopga mana l̈öng l̈i bokshto kuzong ga no ichara ba shäryë ba kong.
Eni ga Juan kägä zara tas, no shdũzl̈ong uyo roshko,
ga söra, twara kjogl̈o l̈i kong kjwl̈ë roshko. Eshko ga kjrara, ga söra, twara ba mekë kong.
E irgo ga Juan oppinggaga öör l̈ok ba doyo kjrë, ga söra, jnena l̈ok sakshko. E irgo ga öötong l̈öng Jesús shäng l̈ishko ga roy l̈ara l̈ok ba kong pjire.
Jesús nopga sëno dogl̈o sak dbäw dbäw pjl̈ogl̈o shkëng (5,000)

Juan roy kuya Jesúsdë ga opshino shäng l̈ishko dwayo ga opyono kjyong roshko, ga to kjok shto obl̈ë, ber sök tjoksa wl̈o. Gueniyo ga miydara kjok eshko sopgarë, ga to jek l̈ok ara ba irgo pjö l̈ëkong.
E irgo ga Jesús opshino kjyong roshko dwayoshko ga nopga ëng töno träk l̇l̇ëm l̈i ĩna, ga songe l̈e, ga swl̈opga söra l̈ok tjeng eshko l̈i poptara pjire.

Kjok ro zar kjwl̈ë kuzong ga ba oppinggaga tjl̈ẽ l̈ok ba kong ga «Kjok sëng tjän. Kjok ëreshko l̇l̇ëye drete. Pjl̈ú wl̈o ga nopga kjwe ichos to na dwayo, jek l̇l̇ëbo soynekoba kjone l̈ishko, dl̈i tjwl̈ẽk wl̈o» l̈e.
Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Brik l̈ok l̇l̇ëm ga pjl̈úe. Së̃zĩ pjãydë dey» l̈e.
Kuya l̈ok ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Ëreshko tjawa pjl̈ung shosho suk pjir tjeng kjwo shkëng (5), mã tjeng do pjök erä» l̈e.
Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Tek sözĩ bor kong» l̈e.

Eni ga nopga tjeng kjl̈obi l̈i ichara wl̈ar uunkong töshko, shkwamsho kjing go. Pjir ga pjl̈ung shosho suk pjir kjwo shkëng (5) l̈i, mã do pjök l̈i, e kjrara Jesúsdë, ga kjok dogo ĩya jem drëng ga tjl̈ẽ Sbö kong ga «Tjawa kong dl̈i tworop ëre. Tjawa ber wopjl̈ú bop tjok e kjĩshko» l̈e. E irgo ga pjl̈ung shosho suk pjir l̈i tora, ga twara ba oppinggaga kong. Ga pjl̈orgara l̈ok nopga l̈öng kës l̈i kong.
Nopga uunkong iono beno l̈öng bö tjung, wopjl̈úe. E irgo ga dl̈i worbo töna ba oppinggagarë l̈ok shing roshko, beno tjeng shing kjwo sak kjwara kjingsho pjök (12), tjung tjunge.
Domerga iono uunkong dogl̈o sak dbäw dbäw pjl̈ogl̈o shkëng (5,000) dik. Wal̈ëga, kjwozirga, e shtak l̇l̇ëme.
Jesús jëktong di kjing go
E irgo ga Jesús ba oppinggaga ichono opyë kjyong roshko, dipzë di bäng buk kësbang l̈i kjwo kal̈ëkong wl̈o. Nopga brik l̈ok wopro ga Jesús beno shäng eshko.
Briktong pjir ga Jesús jem öötong shäng dl̈up go tjoksa, syõshtë Sbö kong eshko wl̈o. Eni ga kjok ro zoktong shäng eshko tjoksa.
Eshko ga kjyong l̈i jek öötong buk pjola tjän, ga jõya di iõya ararë, pjl̈uk tek jong ba shwo l̈ëkong kjĩshko.
Kjok shränto ga Jesús jek jëk shäng di l̈i kjing go, ba oppinggaga l̈öng l̈i shwo l̈ëkong.
Ĩya l̈ok ga bangkjre l̈ok ara, ga tjl̈ẽ ëng kong ga «¡Kjwe äya jl̈õe!» l̈e.
Jekdo eshko ga Jesús tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «¡Pjãy wokjange! ¡Tja l̈i jekdo shäng! L̇l̇ëye bangkjrëmi l̇l̇ëme» l̈e.
Eni ga Pedro tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Tjl̈apga, pja jl̈õ ga tja ichos jek jëk di kjing go, äär bop shwoy wl̈o» l̈e.
Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Pja tegö» l̈e. Kuya Pedrorë ga opshino kjyong roy dwayo, ga jëktong jek di kjing go, Jesús shwo l̈ëkong.
Eshko ga ĩya ga pjl̈uk tjwe jong dbo ara ga bangkjrara, ga pir jer jong, ga tjl̈ẽ ga «¡Tjl̈apga, tja kjimtozong!» l̈e.
Eshko ga shara Jesúsdë jekdo ba orkwo go, ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Pja mär bor go jl̈õkoyo l̇l̇ëme. ¿Pja kjimtër l̇l̇ëme l̈orop ega?» l̈e.
E irgo ga opyono l̈ok kjyong l̈i roshkoshko ga pjl̈uk l̈i beno tjëksoe.
Eshko ga beno l̈öng kjyong roshko l̈i, Jesús poshrëra, ga tjl̈ẽ l̈ok ba kong ga «Pja Sbö Wa jl̈õe» l̈e.
Swl̈opga poptara Jesúsdë Genesaret kjokyo
Dipzono l̈ok di bäng buk kësbang l̈i kjwo kal̈ëkongshko ga öötong l̈öng Genesaret kjokyo.
Jesús miydara kjok eshko sopgarëshko ga roy shdöra l̈ok kjok eshko kjwang jĩkong. Eni ga swl̈opga söra l̈ok ba kong,
tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Swl̈opga kjwe ichos bop shwong worbo porwë sira döe» l̈e. Ga porwara, ga poptono jekdo uunkong.

footnotes.text: Pjl̈u Herodes, e kowëba Herodes Antipas bakoe.
